The Free plan includes 1,000 API credits that renew every month. Paid plans can use Auto-Topup in 1K-credit blocks: Developer $3.00, Pro $2.00, Growth $1.50, Scale $1.00, and Scale 2.5M $0.75 for new subscriptions. Existing subscriptions keep their rates. With insufficient credits and no available top-up, any plan returns 401 USAGE\_EXCEEDED. Logo Link has a separate quota.
